Privacy policy

Updated October 1, 2026. This describes the current Anime Shuffle app, including the GitHub Pages demo and the server version.

What the app stores

Your reactions, saved anime, display settings and guest viewing preferences are stored in your browser. Clearing site data removes them. They do not sync between browsers.

If you create an Anime Shuffle account, the app server stores your username, salted password hash and viewing preferences. It does not ask for an email address. With MyAnimeList sign-in, the server stores your MAL account identifier with your viewing preferences. Account records remain until removed by the operator. Hosting backups may retain earlier copies.

MyAnimeList access

Signing in redirects you to MyAnimeList for authorization. Anime Shuffle never receives your MAL password. Access and refresh tokens, imported profile and list data are held in server memory for your session. Sessions expire after eight hours, and restarting the server signs users out. Public anime metadata may be cached temporarily.

Currently watching and plan to watch entries, available ratings and your reactions help rank suggestions. Ratings are optional. Adding shows to MAL requires your action or enabling the optional auto-add setting. Good and Bad do not change MAL ratings or viewing statuses.

Cookies and third parties

The server version uses an essential session cookie. The app includes no advertising or analytics scripts. GitHub Pages, the hosting provider and MyAnimeList process requests needed to provide their services and may retain their own operational logs. Demo cover images load directly from MyAnimeList; in the server version they pass through the app server.

Your choices

You can clear reactions from Privacy in the app, clear browser site data, sign out, and revoke app authorization on MyAnimeList. Signing out does not delete account records or undo changes to your MAL list. The prototype has no self-service account deletion or password recovery yet.

For questions or to arrange removal of server account data, contact the project maintainer through the project repository. Do not post passwords, tokens or private account information in a public issue.
